name: Queen At Arms
source: As a young girl, Marcus Cordale was rescued from a violent political coup and taken away from the country of her birth. To protect her identity, she was raised as a boy. On her eighteenth birthday she joins the army of Orthera, in search of her elder brother. But when war breaks out, the Ortheran army is thrown into turmoil, and the young recruit is catapulted through the ranks. Can she step up to lead, and wage a battle against the kingdom that she once called home?
translation: 作为一个年轻女孩，马库斯·科代尔从一场暴力政治政变中获救，并被带离了她的出生国。为了保护她的身份，她被当作男孩抚养长大。在十八岁生日那天，她加入了奥瑟拉军队，寻找她的哥哥。但当战争爆发时，奥瑟军队陷入混乱，这位年轻的新兵迅速晋升。她能否挺身而出，向她曾经称之为家园的王国发起一场战斗？
